text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer squeezed out every last 
ounce of her strength, claiming a 
brilliant victory in the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Mejiro Palmer is 
congratulated by Mejiro Ryan. Ryan also 
comments that Palmer's expression has 
grown much fiercer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That was proof that she had gradually 
become able to show her true seriousness. 
Mejiro Palmer vowed to continue changing 
people's impressions of her.
